HOME SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.

13. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family.

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

18. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .

21. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Housing the Family and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
